footer.tagline: High-end tailoring, a fully digital experience.

home.titolo2: Customize it online, try it in the atelier.
home.lead: Browse the collection, configure your made-to-measure garment and get a quote in minutes — or book an in-store appointment for repairs, hemming and more complex tailoring.
home.comeFunzionaTitolo: From measurements to quote, in three steps
home.step1Testo: Enter your body measurements to get a realistic preview of how garments would fit your figure.
home.step2Testo: Choose cut, material and color from preset sketches and preview the final result on screen.
home.step3Testo: Get an approximate quote, including an in-store fitting, and book your appointment.
home.serviziTitolo: When you need a tailor's hand
home.riparazioniTesto: Zippers, tears, invisible mending. Your garment comes back like new, often better.
home.orliTesto: Lengths, takes-in, adjustments. The perfect fit in just a few days.
home.complessiTesto: Important pieces — ceremonies, special events — that need multiple live fittings and handwork.
home.contattaciTesto: Tell us what you need: we'll get back to you within a day with a transparent quote.
